title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E10 — Joan Rivers, Frank Gorshin, The Temptations
Joan does seated stand-up; a Godfather spoof shows off Gorshin’s many voices and The Temptations join Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E11 — Dom DeLuise, Gladys Knight, Raymond Burr
Flip shows how to switch up a joke; the cast does wacky soap opera; Q&A with Raymond who also visits Charley’s Diner.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E12 — Tony Randall, Burns & Schreiber
Window washer (Flip) advises corporate execs; Burns & Schreiber do their taxi routine and Tony's a Chinese football doctor.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E13 — Bill Russell, Johnny Cash, June Carter
Flip plays Bill Russell in a game of 1-on-1 (chess, that is) and Geraldine square dances with Johnny Cash.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E19 — Black Fire
Guests include musical attractions Exuma, Taj Mahal, and actress Cicely Tyson, star of the motion picture, Sounder.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E20 — Elements
Guests include Tony Award-winning singer Linda Hopkins and the musical group Earth, Wind & Fire.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E3 — A Run for the Money
George secures a $10,000 pledge for Katherine to run in a 10K charity race, but when she's injured, Webster decides to run for her.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E4 — Read It and Weep
The family thinks Papa has a vision problem, but the truth is that Papa never learned to read.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E5 — Witchbusters
Webster meets a lonely woman on a dare from his friends and finds out that she is not the witch they said she was.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E6 — Kiss Me, Kate
Webster is disillusioned when his TV hero Jed Hammond comes to Chicago and makes a pass at Katherine.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E7 — The Big Sleepover
George and Katherine are delighted when Webster makes a new friend and extends an invitation for a sleepover until they discover that Tony is a girl.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E16 — Smoking in the Girls Room
Tia and Tamera have a new "burning passion" -- for cigarettes.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E17 — Playing Hooky
Tia and Tamera are caught in the middle when Ray and Lisa square off over Lisa's decision to let the twins "play hooky" from school.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E18 — Single White Teenager
When Tia's out sick from school, Tamera befriends a new girl who becomes obsessed with looking and acting like the twins.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E19 — I Do?
Lisa gets "cold feet" after Terrence pops the question, while the twins worry that Lisa's marriage means they'll stop living under the same roof.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E1 — The Natural
Tia rearranges her class schedule in order to spend more time with the school "stud"; Tamera is tapped to pitch a big softball game.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E13 — OhMiGod, Fanatic
After Moesha and Kim have a huge fight, Moesha is surprised when MTV shows up at her door to film her bringing her best friend Kim to meet her favorite singer.  Leanne Rimes guest stars.
